name: Goo dbad
description: discuss common issues and give your opinions
author: IELTS Practice Team

questions.text: What do you think is the biggest problem facing cities today?
Do you think making mistakes is good or bad when learning a new skill?
Can a small change in daily habits lead to a big improvement in a person's health?
Why do some people prefer living in a small town rather than a big city?
Do you think social media has a good or bad effect on how young people communicate?
Do you think that watching television is generally good or bad for young children?
What are the consequences of having a bad diet in modern society?
Is it always a good idea to ask older people for advice about your career?
Why do some people think that owning a car is a bad thing for the environment?
Do you think that competition between students is a good thing for their development?
